title: Claude Code conversations
description: Claude Code sessions as conversations: the list, then for a selected conversation its talks (prompt, reply and what the agent did), a flow timeline and the talk's trace, every step, an inspector for one step (details, evidence, changes), and every file change. Text, commands, outputs and diffs need the agent-side settings OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS, OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT.

list.name: persona
list.label: Persona
list.description: persona resource attribute (persona=<name> in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES); All also matches data without one.

list.name: session
list.label: Conversation
list.description: Claude Code session (session.id). Set by clicking a Conversation; All shows only the Conversations list.

list.name: prompt
list.label: Talk
list.description: prompt_id of the selected talk; .* = every talk of the conversation. Set by clicking a Talk.

list.name: tool
list.label: Step
list.description: tool_use_id of the step shown in the Inspector; empty = none. Set by clicking a Step.

list.name: trace
list.label: Trace
list.description: trace id shown in the Trace panel; empty = none. Set by clicking a Talk or a Step.

list.name: traceq
list.label: Trace query
list.description: Trace, or { false } when Trace is empty (internal).

panels.title: Conversations
panels.description: One row per Claude Code session (conversation) with telemetry in the time range, newest activity first; follows VM, User and Persona, ignores Session. Click a Conversation to open it: it sets Session, clears Prompt, Step and Trace, and narrows the time range to that conversation. Title is the first logged prompt (needs OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1; empty otherwise). Started and Last activity are the first and last Loki event in the range. Talks (prompts), Model calls, Subagents, Bash runs and Failed tools come from Loki events. Files changed counts distinct file paths of Edit/Write calls (from tool_input, so it needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1; empty when no tool call of the session carried details). Lines +/-, Tokens, Cache read (cache-read share of input tokens) and Cost come from Prometheus. Teammate and subagent sessions send no prompts, so they show 0 Talks. Above about 1000 sessions in the range the panel fails with a Loki series-limit error: narrow the time range.

targets.expr: group by (session_id, host_name, user_email, persona) (last_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona"}[$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "host_name", "-", "", ""), "user_email", "-", "", ""), "persona", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id, k) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "cost", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "tokens", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona", type="cacheRead"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "cache_read", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona", type=~"input|cacheRead|cacheCreation"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "tok_in", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona", type="added"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "lines_added", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", persona=~"$persona", type="removed"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "lines_removed", "", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "k", "-", "", "")

min by (session_id, host_name) (min_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id!="" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "host_name", "-", "", "")

max by (session_id) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id!="" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id, user_email, persona) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id!="" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "user_email", "-", "", ""), "persona", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="user_prompt" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="Bash" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="tool_result" | success!="true" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_input!="" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

count by (session_id) (sum by (session_id, fp) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit" | tool_input!="" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" | line_format `{{ .tool_input }}` | json fp="file_path" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | fp!="" [$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

{service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | event_name="user_prompt" | prompt!="" | prompt!="<REDACTED>" | user_email=~"$user" | persona=~"$persona" | keep session_id, prompt | label_format prompt=`{{ trunc 160 .prompt }}`

targets.expression:
WITH tt AS (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.session_id')) AS sid, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt')) AS p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.session_id')) ORDER BY tsNs) AS rn FROM LT),
t AS (SELECT sid, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p, CHAR(13), ''), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(9), ' ') AS title FROM tt WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT
  SUBSTRING(ids.session_id, 1, 8) AS `Conversation`,
  COALESCE(t.title, '') AS `Title`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(st.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Started`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(en.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Last activity`,
  (en.__value__ - st.__value__) / 1000 AS `Span`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.host_name, ''), st.host_name, '') AS `VM`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.persona, ''), NULLIF(li.persona, ''), '') AS `Persona`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.user_email, ''), NULLIF(li.user_email, ''), '') AS `User`,
  COALESCE(lp.__value__, 0) AS `Talks`,
  COALESCE(la.__value__, 0) AS `Model calls`,
  COALESCE(lg.__value__, 0) AS `Subagents`,
  COALESCE(lb.__value__, 0) AS `Bash runs`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ld.__value__, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(lc.__value__, 0) END AS `Files changed`,
  CONCAT('+', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(n.lines_added, 0)) AS SIGNED), ' -', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(n.lines_removed, 0)) AS SIGNED)) AS `Lines +/-`,
  COALESCE(n.tokens, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  CASE WHEN n.tok_in > 0 THEN n.cache_read / n.tok_in END AS `Cache read`,
  COALESCE(n.cost, 0) AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(lf.__value__, 0) AS `Failed tools`,
  CAST(CAST(st.__value__ AS SIGNED) - 60000 AS CHAR) AS start_ms,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(en.__value__ AS SIGNED) + 60000 AS CHAR), '') AS end_ms,
  ids.session_id AS session_id
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM A UNION SELECT session_id FROM LS) ids
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(host_name) AS host_name, MAX(user_email) AS user_email, MAX(persona) AS persona
           FROM A GROUP BY session_id) a ON a.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(NULLIF(user_email, '')) AS user_email, MAX(NULLIF(persona, '')) AS persona
           FROM LI GROUP BY session_id) li ON li.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LS st ON st.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LE en ON en.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cost' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cost,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'tokens' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS tokens,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cache_read' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cache_read,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'tok_in' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS tok_in,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'lines_added' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS lines_added,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'lines_removed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS lines_removed
           FROM N GROUP BY session_id) n ON n.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LP lp ON lp.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LA la ON la.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LG lg ON lg.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LB lb ON lb.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LF lf ON lf.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LD ld ON ld.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LC lc ON lc.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN t ON t.sid = ids.session_id
WHERE ids.session_id <> '-' AND st.__value__ IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Last activity` DESC

panels.title: Talks
panels.description: One row per prompt (talk) of the selected conversation, in order. Prompt and Response show the text in a code block when the agent runs with OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1, otherwise "not logged" and the length; Response is the last main-thread reply of the prompt ("no text reply" when the prompt ended on a tool call). What the agent did: steps = tool calls on the main thread (the first 40 are listed with their offset from the prompt, ok/FAIL, tool, and command or file; commands and files need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1), workflow runs = Workflow tool runs, tool calls = all tool calls including those inside workflows, then the time from the prompt to its last event. Click the summary to expand the list. Tokens and Cost are summed from the prompt's api_request events. Click a Talk to select it for Flow, Trace and Steps; click a Trace to open it in Explore. Lists use the newest 5000 main-thread tool calls of the conversation in the range.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="user_prompt" | keep prompt_id, trace_id, prompt, prompt_length, command_name
{service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="assistant_response" | query_source=~"repl_main_thread.*|sdk" | keep prompt_id, response, response_length

{service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="tool_result" | workflow_run_id="" | keep prompt_id, trace_id, tool_name, tool_use_id, tool_parameters, tool_input, success, duration_ms, decision_type, decision_source, tool_result_size_bytes, workflow_run_id

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="api_request" | label_format tok=`{{ add .input_tokens .output_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_creation_tokens }}` | unwrap tok | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="tool_result" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

count by (prompt_id) (sum by (prompt_id, workflow_run_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | workflow_run_id!="" [$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

min by (prompt_id) (min_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name=~"user_prompt|api_request|tool_result|assistant_response|subagent_completed|compaction" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

max by (prompt_id) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name=~"user_prompt|api_request|tool_result|assistant_response|subagent_completed|compaction" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

targets.expression:
WITH RECURSIVE
pp AS (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.trace_id')) AS trace_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt')) AS prompt,
             JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_length')) AS prompt_length, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.command_name')), '') AS command_name, tsNs,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tsNs) AS n
      FROM P),
rr AS (SELECT prompt_id, response, response_length FROM (
        SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.response')) AS response, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.response_length')) AS response_length,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) ORDER BY tsNs DESC) AS rn
        FROM R) x WHERE rn = 1),
tlim AS (SELECT labels, tsNs FROM (
  SELECT labels, tsNs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) ORDER BY tsNs) AS rn FROM T) x WHERE rn <= 40),
t0 AS (SELECT
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.trace_id')) AS trace_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_name')) AS tool, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_use_id')) AS tool_use_id,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.success')) AS success, CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.duration_ms')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.duration_ms')) AS SIGNED) END AS duration_ms, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.decision_type')) AS decision,
  CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_result_size_bytes')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_result_size_bytes')) AS SIGNED) END AS out_size, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.workflow_run_id')), '') AS wf,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_parameters')), '') AS tp, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_input')), '') AS ti, tsNs
  FROM tlim),
t1 AS (SELECT t0.*,
  CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(tp) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(tp) = 'OBJECT' THEN tp ELSE '{}' END ELSE '{}' END AS tpj,
  CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(ti) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(ti) = 'OBJECT' THEN ti ELSE '{}' END ELSE '{}' END AS tij
  FROM t0),
t2 AS (SELECT t1.*,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.full_command')) AS p_cmd, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.skill_name')) AS p_skill, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.subagent_type')) AS p_sub, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.mcp_server_name')) AS p_mcps, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.mcp_tool_name')) AS p_mcpt,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.file_path')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.notebook_path')),
           CASE WHEN tij = '{}' AND LOCATE('"file_path":"', ti) > 0
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ti, '"file_path":"', -1), '"', 1) END) AS i_file,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.command')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.pattern')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.url')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.query')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.skill')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.description'))) AS i_other
  FROM t1),
t3 AS (SELECT t2.*,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p_cmd, ''),
           CASE WHEN p_mcps IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(p_mcps, ' / ', COALESCE(p_mcpt, '')) END,
           NULLIF(p_skill, ''), NULLIF(p_sub, ''),
           CASE WHEN i_file IS NULL THEN NULLIF(i_other, '') END, '') AS cmd,
  COALESCE(i_file, '') AS file
  FROM t2),
ts AS (SELECT t3.prompt_id, t3.tool, t3.success, t3.cmd, t3.file, t3.tsNs,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.prompt_id ORDER BY t3.tsNs) AS rn
       FROM t3 WHERE t3.wf = ''),
tl AS (SELECT ts.prompt_id, ts.rn, CONCAT(
         '+', FLOOR((CAST(ts.tsNs AS SIGNED) - CAST(pp.tsNs AS SIGNED)) / 60000000000), ':',
         RIGHT(CONCAT('0', FLOOR((CAST(ts.tsNs AS SIGNED) - CAST(pp.tsNs AS SIGNED)) / 1000000000) % 60), 2), ' ',
         CASE WHEN ts.success = 'true' THEN 'ok  ' ELSE 'FAIL' END, ' ', ts.tool,
         CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(ts.tool) < 6 THEN REPEAT(' ', 6 - CHAR_LENGTH(ts.tool)) ELSE '' END,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.cmd, ''), ts.file) <> '' THEN CONCAT('  ',
           LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.cmd, ''), ts.file), CHAR(13), ''), CHAR(10), ' ⏎ '), 160),
           CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(ts.cmd, ''), ts.file)) > 160 THEN '…' ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END) AS line
       FROM ts JOIN pp ON pp.prompt_id = ts.prompt_id WHERE ts.rn <= 40),
acc (prompt_id, rn, txt) AS (SELECT prompt_id, rn, line FROM tl WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL SELECT acc.prompt_id, tl.rn, CONCAT(acc.txt, CHAR(10), tl.line) FROM acc JOIN tl ON tl.prompt_id = acc.prompt_id AND tl.rn = acc.rn + 1),
lists AS (SELECT acc.prompt_id, acc.txt FROM acc JOIN (SELECT prompt_id, MAX(rn) AS m FROM tl GROUP BY prompt_id) mx
          ON mx.prompt_id = acc.prompt_id AND mx.m = acc.rn),
cnt AS (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, COUNT(*) AS main_steps FROM T GROUP BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id'))),
w AS (SELECT pp.prompt_id, COALESCE(c.main_steps, 0) AS steps, CAST(COALESCE(pw.__value__, 0) AS SIGNED) AS runs,
             CAST(COALESCE(pt.__value__, 0) AS SIGNED) AS tools,
             CASE WHEN pe.__value__ >= pf.__value__ THEN FLOOR((pe.__value__ - pf.__value__) / 1000) ELSE 0 END AS secs
      FROM pp LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id LEFT JOIN PW pw ON pw.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id
      LEFT JOIN PT pt ON pt.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id LEFT JOIN PF pf ON pf.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id LEFT JOIN PE pe ON pe.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id),
ws AS (SELECT prompt_id, steps, CONCAT(
         steps, CASE WHEN steps = 1 THEN ' step' ELSE ' steps' END, ' · ',
         runs, CASE WHEN runs = 1 THEN ' workflow run' ELSE ' workflow runs' END, ' · ',
         tools, CASE WHEN tools = 1 THEN ' tool call' ELSE ' tool calls' END, ' · ',
         CASE WHEN secs >= 3600 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(secs / 3600), 'h ', FLOOR(secs / 60) % 60, 'm')
              WHEN secs >= 60 THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(secs / 60), 'm ', secs % 60, 's') ELSE CONCAT(secs, 's') END) AS summary
       FROM w)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT
  NULLIF(pp.n, -1) AS `#`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(CAST(pp.tsNs AS SIGNED) / 1000000000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Time`,
  COALESCE(SUBSTRING(pp.prompt_id, 1, 8), '') AS `Talk`,
  CASE WHEN pp.command_name IN ('', '-') THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('/', pp.command_name) END AS `Command`,
  CASE WHEN pp.prompt IS NULL OR pp.prompt = '' OR pp.prompt = '<REDACTED>'
       THEN CONCAT('not logged · ', COALESCE(pp.prompt_length, '?'), ' chars')
       ELSE CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~', CHAR(10), REPLACE(CONCAT(LEFT(pp.prompt, 2000), CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(pp.prompt) > 2000 THEN CONCAT(CHAR(10), '[', CHAR_LENGTH(pp.prompt), ' chars, first 2000 shown]') ELSE '' END), '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~') END AS `Prompt`,
  CASE WHEN rr.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 'no text reply'
       WHEN rr.response IS NULL OR rr.response = '' OR rr.response = '<REDACTED>'
       THEN CONCAT('not logged · ', COALESCE(rr.response_length, '?'), ' chars')
       ELSE CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~', CHAR(10), REPLACE(CONCAT(LEFT(rr.response, 2000), CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(rr.response) > 2000 THEN CONCAT(CHAR(10), '[', CHAR_LENGTH(rr.response), ' chars, first 2000 shown]') ELSE '' END), '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~') END AS `Response`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ws.steps, 0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(ws.summary, '')
       ELSE CONCAT('<details><summary>', ws.summary, '</summary>', CHAR(10), CHAR(10),
         CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~', CHAR(10), REPLACE(CONCAT(l.txt, CASE WHEN ws.steps > 40 THEN CONCAT(CHAR(10), '… ', ws.steps - 40, ' more in Steps') ELSE '' END), '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~'),
         CHAR(10), CHAR(10), '</details>') END AS `What the agent did`,
  COALESCE(pk.__value__, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  COALESCE(pc.__value__, 0) AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(pp.trace_id, '') AS `Trace`,
  COALESCE(pp.prompt_id, '') AS prompt_id,
  COALESCE(pp.trace_id, '') AS trace_id
FROM pp
LEFT JOIN rr ON rr.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN ws ON ws.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN lists l ON l.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PK pk ON pk.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PC pc ON pc.prompt_id = pp.prompt_id
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, '', '', 'No talks: pick a conversation in Conversations above (Conversation = All shows none), or this conversation sent no prompts in the time range (teammate and subagent sessions send none).',
       '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM P) e WHERE e.c = 0
) u ORDER BY 1

value.title: Select this talk: its flow, trace and steps

panels.title: Flow
panels.description: What the selected conversation (and Prompt, when one is selected) did over time, one lane per kind: Prompt (user_prompt), Model (api_request), one "Tool: <name>" lane per tool that ran (tool_result), Workflows (events of Workflow tool runs), Subagents (subagent_completed, at the end of the subagent), Failed (tool_result with success other than true) and API errors (no lane while there are none). A block means at least one event in the time bucket ($__auto, which grows with the time range), not how long the work took. Empty until a conversation is selected.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | event_name="user_prompt" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))
sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | event_name="api_request" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | event_name="tool_result" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))
sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | workflow_run_id!="" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))
sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | event_name="subagent_completed" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))
sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | event_name="tool_result" | success!="true" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))
sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | event_name="api_error" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))

panels.title: Trace of the selected talk
panels.description: The Tempo trace of the selected talk (one trace per prompt: claude_code.interaction with its model calls and tool spans). Set by clicking a Talk or a Step (the Trace variable holds its trace id); empty until then. With OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1, tool spans carry a tool.output event with the file content, command output or Edit diff (open a span and its Events); Tempo keeps the first 2 KB of each value unless max_attribute_bytes is raised.

panels.title: Steps
panels.description: Every tool call (tool_result event) of the selected conversation and Prompt, in order: tool, command (Bash command line, MCP server / tool, skill, subagent type, search pattern or URL) and file, success, duration, permission decision, output size, and the workflow run it belongs to. Command and File need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 (empty otherwise; Claude Code shortens long strings in tool_input). Click a Step to inspect it below; click a Trace to open it in Explore. Shows the newest 5000 tool calls: select a talk for older ones.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id="$session" | event_name="tool_result" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | keep prompt_id, trace_id, tool_name, tool_use_id, tool_parameters, tool_input, success, duration_ms, decision_type, decision_source, tool_result_size_bytes, workflow_run_id

targets.expression:
WITH t0 AS (SELECT
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS prompt_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.trace_id')) AS trace_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_name')) AS tool, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_use_id')) AS tool_use_id,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.success')) AS success, CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.duration_ms')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.duration_ms')) AS SIGNED) END AS duration_ms, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.decision_type')) AS decision,
  CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_result_size_bytes')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_result_size_bytes')) AS SIGNED) END AS out_size, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.workflow_run_id')), '') AS wf,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_parameters')), '') AS tp, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(labels, '$.tool_input')), '') AS ti, tsNs
  FROM T),
t1 AS (SELECT t0.*,
  CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(tp) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(tp) = 'OBJECT' THEN tp ELSE '{}' END ELSE '{}' END AS tpj,
  CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(ti) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(ti) = 'OBJECT' THEN ti ELSE '{}' END ELSE '{}' END AS tij
  FROM t0),
t2 AS (SELECT t1.*,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.full_command')) AS p_cmd, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.skill_name')) AS p_skill, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.subagent_type')) AS p_sub, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.mcp_server_name')) AS p_mcps, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tpj, '$.mcp_tool_name')) AS p_mcpt,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.file_path')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.notebook_path')),
           CASE WHEN tij = '{}' AND LOCATE('"file_path":"', ti) > 0
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ti, '"file_path":"', -1), '"', 1) END) AS i_file,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.command')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.pattern')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.url')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.query')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.skill')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tij, '$.description'))) AS i_other
  FROM t1),
t3 AS (SELECT t2.*,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p_cmd, ''),
           CASE WHEN p_mcps IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(p_mcps, ' / ', COALESCE(p_mcpt, '')) END,
           NULLIF(p_skill, ''), NULLIF(p_sub, ''),
           CASE WHEN i_file IS NULL THEN NULLIF(i_other, '') END, '') AS cmd,
  COALESCE(i_file, '') AS file
  FROM t2)
SELECT
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(CAST(tsNs AS SIGNED) / 1000000000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Time`,
  COALESCE(RIGHT(tool_use_id, 8), '') AS `Step`,
  COALESCE(tool, '') AS `Tool`,
  cmd AS `Command`,
  file AS `File`,
  COALESCE(success, '') AS `Success`,
  duration_ms AS `Duration`,
  COALESCE(decision, '') AS `Decision`,
  out_size AS `Output size`,
  CASE WHEN wf = '' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(wf, 1, 8) END AS `Workflow run`,
  SUBSTRING(COALESCE(prompt_id, ''), 1, 8) AS `Talk`,
  COALESCE(trace_id, '') AS `Trace`,
  COALESCE(tool_use_id, '') AS tool_use_id, COALESCE(trace_id, '') AS trace_id_raw, COALESCE(prompt_id, '') AS prompt_id,
  tsNs AS ts_ns
FROM t3
ORDER BY tsNs

panels.title: Step details
panels.description: All fields of the selected step's tool_result event (Loki), one per row: outcome and timing first, then tool_parameters.* and tool_input.* (parsed from their JSON; both need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1), then the raw values and the remaining metadata. A tool_input cut by Claude Code at about 4 KB is not valid JSON, so only its raw value is shown. Hover a long value and click the eye icon for all of it.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id=~"$session" | tool_use_id="$tool" | tool_use_id!="" | event_name="tool_result"

targets.expression:
WITH e AS (SELECT labels FROM A ORDER BY tsNs DESC LIMIT 1),
kv AS (SELECT jt.k, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.labels, CONCAT('$."', jt.k, '"'))) AS v
       FROM e, JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(e.labels), '$[*]' COLUMNS (k TEXT PATH '$')) jt),
nested AS (SELECT kv.k AS parent, CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(kv.v) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(kv.v) = 'OBJECT' THEN kv.v ELSE '{}' END ELSE '{}' END AS o
           FROM kv WHERE kv.k IN ('tool_parameters', 'tool_input')),
sub AS (SELECT CONCAT(nested.parent, '.', jt.k) AS k, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(nested.o, CONCAT('$."', jt.k, '"'))) AS v,
               CASE WHEN nested.parent = 'tool_parameters' THEN 100 ELSE 200 END AS o
        FROM nested, JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(nested.o), '$[*]' COLUMNS (k TEXT PATH '$')) jt),
allkv AS (SELECT k, v, CASE k WHEN 'tool_name' THEN 0 WHEN 'success' THEN 1 WHEN 'error_type' THEN 2 WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'duration_ms' THEN 4 WHEN 'decision_type' THEN 5 WHEN 'decision_source' THEN 6 WHEN 'tool_input_size_bytes' THEN 7 WHEN 'tool_result_size_bytes' THEN 8 WHEN 'workflow_run_id' THEN 9 WHEN 'tool_use_id' THEN 10 WHEN 'prompt_id' THEN 11 WHEN 'trace_id' THEN 12 WHEN 'span_id' THEN 13 WHEN 'session_id' THEN 14 WHEN 'event_timestamp' THEN 15 WHEN 'event_sequence' THEN 16 WHEN 'model' THEN 17 ELSE 900 END AS o FROM kv
          UNION ALL SELECT k, v, o FROM sub)
SELECT `Field`, `Content` FROM (
  SELECT k AS `Field`, v AS `Content`, o FROM allkv WHERE v IS NOT NULL AND v <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '', CASE WHEN ${tool:sqlstring} = '' THEN 'Pick a step: click a Step id in Steps.' ELSE 'No tool_result event for this step in the time range.' END, -1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM A) z WHERE z.c = 0
) x ORDER BY o, `Field`

panels.title: Evidence
panels.description: What the selected step saw, from the tool.output event on its Tempo span: a Read's file content, a Bash command and its output, MCP, WebFetch and WebSearch output, or a Write's new content. Needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 on the agent (Edit/Write also need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1). Tempo keeps the first 2 KB of each value unless distributor max_attribute_bytes is raised (Note says when a value was cut); Claude Code caps values at 60 KB.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "claude-code" && span.tool_use_id = "$tool" && event:name = "tool.output" } | select(event.content, event.output, event.bash_command, event.file_path, event.diff, span.file_path, span.full_command, span.tool_name, span.tool_use_id)

targets.expression:
WITH ta AS (SELECT jt.traceID, jt.spanID, jt.st, jt.k, jt.v FROM A,
  JSON_TABLE(A.response, '$.traces[*]' COLUMNS (traceID TEXT PATH '$.traceID',
    NESTED PATH '$.spanSets[*]' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.spans[*]' COLUMNS (spanID TEXT PATH '$.spanID', st TEXT PATH '$.startTimeUnixNano',
      NESTED PATH '$.attributes[*]' COLUMNS (k TEXT PATH '$.key', v TEXT PATH '$.value.Value.string_value'))))) jt),
sp AS (SELECT traceID, spanID, MAX(st) AS st,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'tool_name' THEN v END) AS tool,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'tool_use_id' THEN v END) AS tool_use_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'file_path' THEN v END) AS file_path,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'bash_command' THEN v END) AS bash_command,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'full_command' THEN v END) AS full_command,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'output' THEN v END) AS output,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'content' THEN v END) AS content,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'diff' THEN v END) AS diff
  FROM ta WHERE spanID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY traceID, spanID),
ev AS (SELECT sp.*, LENGTH(COALESCE(sp.output, sp.content, sp.diff, '')) AS bytes FROM sp)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT
  COALESCE(tool, '') AS `Tool`,
  COALESCE(file_path, '') AS `File`,
  NULLIF(bytes, -1) AS `Size`,
  CASE WHEN bytes BETWEEN 2045 AND 2051 OR bytes BETWEEN 4093 AND 4099 OR bytes BETWEEN 8189 AND 8195 OR bytes BETWEEN 16381 AND 16387 OR bytes BETWEEN 32765 AND 32771 OR bytes BETWEEN 65533 AND 65539 OR bytes BETWEEN 131069 AND 131075 OR bytes BETWEEN 262141 AND 262147 THEN CONCAT('probably cut by Tempo at ', bytes, ' bytes (max_attribute_bytes): first part only') WHEN bytes >= 61000 THEN 'near the 60 KB cap Claude Code puts on tool content: may be cut' ELSE '' END AS `Note`,
  CASE WHEN diff IS NOT NULL THEN 'An Edit: its diff is in Step changes below.'
       WHEN bash_command IS NOT NULL OR tool = 'Bash' THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~', CHAR(10), REPLACE(CONCAT('$ ', COALESCE(bash_command, full_command, ''), CHAR(10), COALESCE(output, '')), '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~')
       WHEN content IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~', CHAR(10), REPLACE(content, '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~')
       WHEN output IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~', CHAR(10), REPLACE(output, '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~')
       ELSE 'The tool.output event has no content.' END AS `Evidence`
FROM ev
UNION ALL
SELECT '', '', NULL, '', CASE WHEN ${tool:sqlstring} = '' THEN 'Pick a step: click a Step id in Steps.' ELSE 'No tool.output event for this step: Claude Code sends one only with OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 (Edit and Write also need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1), and not for every tool.' END
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM ev) z WHERE z.c = 0) u

panels.title: Step changes
panels.description: The selected step's change as a unified diff: an Edit's hunks (@@ -old +new @@, then context, - and + lines), or a Write's new content as added lines, with the added and removed line counts. From the tool.output event on its Tempo span: needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Tempo keeps the first 2 KB of the diff unless max_attribute_bytes is raised; a cut diff is closed after its last complete line and marked in Note.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "claude-code" && span.tool_use_id = "$tool" && event:name = "tool.output" && span.tool_name =~ "Edit|MultiEdit|Write|NotebookEdit" } | select(event.content, event.output, event.bash_command, event.file_path, event.diff, span.file_path, span.full_command, span.tool_name, span.tool_use_id)

targets.expression:
WITH RECURSIVE ta AS (SELECT jt.traceID, jt.spanID, jt.st, jt.k, jt.v FROM A,
  JSON_TABLE(A.response, '$.traces[*]' COLUMNS (traceID TEXT PATH '$.traceID',
    NESTED PATH '$.spanSets[*]' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.spans[*]' COLUMNS (spanID TEXT PATH '$.spanID', st TEXT PATH '$.startTimeUnixNano',
      NESTED PATH '$.attributes[*]' COLUMNS (k TEXT PATH '$.key', v TEXT PATH '$.value.Value.string_value'))))) jt),
sp AS (SELECT traceID, spanID, MAX(st) AS st,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'tool_name' THEN v END) AS tool,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'tool_use_id' THEN v END) AS tool_use_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'file_path' THEN v END) AS file_path,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'bash_command' THEN v END) AS bash_command,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'full_command' THEN v END) AS full_command,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'output' THEN v END) AS output,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'content' THEN v END) AS content,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'diff' THEN v END) AS diff
  FROM ta WHERE spanID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY traceID, spanID),
src AS (SELECT spanID AS k, tool, file_path, diff, CASE WHEN diff IS NULL THEN content END AS content FROM sp WHERE diff IS NOT NULL OR content IS NOT NULL),
d0a AS (SELECT k, diff AS raw, REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(diff, ''), '\\\\', CHAR(1)), '\\"', CHAR(2)) AS x FROM src),
d0b AS (SELECT k, raw,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(x, '"]}]'), CHAR(2), '\\"'), CHAR(1), '\\\\') AS c1,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(x, ']}]'), CHAR(2), '\\"'), CHAR(1), '\\\\') AS c2,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(LEFT(x, CHAR_LENGTH(x) - CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(x, '","', -1)) - 2), ']}]'), CHAR(2), '\\"'), CHAR(1), '\\\\') AS c3
  FROM d0a),
d0 AS (SELECT k, raw,
  CASE WHEN raw IS NULL OR raw = '' THEN '[]' WHEN JSON_VALID(raw) THEN raw
       WHEN JSON_VALID(c1) THEN c1 WHEN JSON_VALID(c2) THEN c2 WHEN JSON_VALID(c3) THEN c3 ELSE '[]' END AS dj,
  CASE WHEN raw IS NULL OR raw = '' THEN 0 WHEN JSON_VALID(raw) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS cut
  FROM d0b),
h0 AS (SELECT d0.k, jt.hi, jt.os, jt.ol, jt.ns, jt.nl, CAST(jt.lines AS CHAR) AS lj, JSON_LENGTH(jt.lines) AS ln
  FROM d0, JSON_TABLE(d0.dj, '$[*]' COLUMNS (hi FOR ORDINALITY, os INT PATH '$.oldStart', ol INT PATH '$.oldLines',
    ns INT PATH '$.newStart', nl INT PATH '$.newLines', lines JSON PATH '$.lines')) jt),
h1 AS (SELECT k, hi, CASE WHEN ln > 0 THEN
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
      SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(lj, '\\\\', CHAR(1)), '\\"', CHAR(2)), 3, CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(REPLACE(lj, '\\\\', CHAR(1)), '\\"', CHAR(2))) - 4),
      '", "', CHAR(10)), '\\t', CHAR(9)), '\\r', ''), '\\n', CHAR(10)), CHAR(2), '"'), CHAR(1), '\\')
    ELSE '' END AS body,
    CONCAT('@@ -', os, ',', ol, ' +', ns, ',', nl, ' @@') AS head FROM h0),
h2 AS (SELECT k, hi, CONCAT(head, CASE WHEN body <> '' THEN CONCAT(CHAR(10), body) ELSE '' END) AS txt,
    (CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body)) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body), CONCAT(CHAR(10), '+'), ''))) / 2 AS plus,
    (CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body)) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body), CONCAT(CHAR(10), '-'), ''))) / 2 AS minus
  FROM h1),
hc (k, hi, txt) AS (SELECT k, hi, txt FROM h2 WHERE hi = 1
  UNION ALL SELECT hc.k, h2.hi, CONCAT(hc.txt, CHAR(10), h2.txt) FROM hc JOIN h2 ON h2.k = hc.k AND h2.hi = hc.hi + 1),
dt AS (SELECT hc.k, hc.txt, m.plus, m.minus, m.hunks FROM hc
  JOIN (SELECT k, MAX(hi) AS hunks, SUM(plus) AS plus, SUM(minus) AS minus FROM h2 GROUP BY k) m ON m.k = hc.k AND m.hunks = hc.hi),
ch AS (SELECT src.k, src.tool, src.file_path, src.content,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.txt
       WHEN src.content IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('+', REPLACE(src.content, CHAR(10), CONCAT(CHAR(10), '+')))
       WHEN src.diff IS NOT NULL AND src.diff <> '' THEN CONCAT('(no complete diff line before the cut; raw value:)', CHAR(10), src.diff) END AS txt,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.plus WHEN src.content IS NOT NULL THEN CHAR_LENGTH(src.content) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(src.content, CHAR(10), '')) + 1 ELSE 0 END AS plus,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.minus ELSE 0 END AS minus,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.hunks ELSE 0 END AS hunks,
  COALESCE(d0.cut, 0) AS cut,
  CASE WHEN src.diff IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(src.diff) ELSE LENGTH(src.content) END AS bytes
  FROM src LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.k = src.k LEFT JOIN d0 ON d0.k = src.k)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT COALESCE(ch.tool, '') AS `Tool`, COALESCE(ch.file_path, '') AS `File`, ch.plus AS `Added`, ch.minus AS `Removed`,
       CASE WHEN ch.cut = 1 THEN CONCAT('diff cut at ', ch.bytes, ' bytes by Tempo (max_attribute_bytes): later lines missing') ELSE CASE WHEN ch.bytes BETWEEN 2045 AND 2051 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 4093 AND 4099 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 8189 AND 8195 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 16381 AND 16387 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 32765 AND 32771 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 65533 AND 65539 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 131069 AND 131075 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 262141 AND 262147 THEN CONCAT('probably cut by Tempo at ', ch.bytes, ' bytes (max_attribute_bytes): first part only') WHEN ch.bytes >= 61000 THEN 'near the 60 KB cap Claude Code puts on tool content: may be cut' ELSE '' END END AS `Note`, CASE WHEN ch.txt IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~diff', CHAR(10), REPLACE(CONCAT('--- ', COALESCE(ch.file_path, ''), CHAR(10), '+++ ', COALESCE(ch.file_path, ''), CHAR(10), ch.txt), '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~') END AS `Changes`
FROM ch
UNION ALL
SELECT '', '', NULL, NULL, '', CASE WHEN ${tool:sqlstring} = '' THEN 'Pick a step: click a Step id in Steps.' ELSE 'No Edit or Write content for this step: it is not an Edit/Write, or the agent runs without OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1.' END
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM src) z WHERE z.c = 0) u

panels.title: Changes
panels.description: Every Edit and Write of the selected conversation, newest first, from the tool.output events on its Tempo spans: the file, added and removed lines, and the change as a unified diff (File shows the last two path parts, the diff header the full path; click +N -M to expand; a Write shows its new content as added lines). Needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 on the agent. Tempo keeps the first 2 KB of each diff unless max_attribute_bytes is raised; a cut diff is closed after its last complete line and marked in Note. Covers up to 100 prompts (traces) with up to 100 edits each in the range. Click a Step to inspect it.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "claude-code" && span.session.id = "$session" && event:name = "tool.output" && span.tool_name =~ "Edit|MultiEdit|Write|NotebookEdit" } | select(event.content, event.output, event.bash_command, event.file_path, event.diff, span.file_path, span.full_command, span.tool_name, span.tool_use_id)

WITH RECURSIVE ta AS (SELECT jt.traceID, jt.spanID, jt.st, jt.k, jt.v FROM A,
  JSON_TABLE(A.response, '$.traces[*]' COLUMNS (traceID TEXT PATH '$.traceID',
    NESTED PATH '$.spanSets[*]' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.spans[*]' COLUMNS (spanID TEXT PATH '$.spanID', st TEXT PATH '$.startTimeUnixNano',
      NESTED PATH '$.attributes[*]' COLUMNS (k TEXT PATH '$.key', v TEXT PATH '$.value.Value.string_value'))))) jt),
sp AS (SELECT traceID, spanID, MAX(st) AS st,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'tool_name' THEN v END) AS tool,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'tool_use_id' THEN v END) AS tool_use_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'file_path' THEN v END) AS file_path,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k = 'bash_command' THEN v END) AS bash_command,

src AS (SELECT spanID AS k, tool, file_path, diff, CASE WHEN diff IS NULL THEN content END AS content FROM sp WHERE diff IS NOT NULL OR content IS NOT NULL),
d0a AS (SELECT k, diff AS raw, REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(diff, ''), '\\\\', CHAR(1)), '\\"', CHAR(2)) AS x FROM src),
d0b AS (SELECT k, raw,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(x, '"]}]'), CHAR(2), '\\"'), CHAR(1), '\\\\') AS c1,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(x, ']}]'), CHAR(2), '\\"'), CHAR(1), '\\\\') AS c2,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CONCAT(LEFT(x, CHAR_LENGTH(x) - CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(x, '","', -1)) - 2), ']}]'), CHAR(2), '\\"'), CHAR(1), '\\\\') AS c3
  FROM d0a),
d0 AS (SELECT k, raw,
  CASE WHEN raw IS NULL OR raw = '' THEN '[]' WHEN JSON_VALID(raw) THEN raw
       WHEN JSON_VALID(c1) THEN c1 WHEN JSON_VALID(c2) THEN c2 WHEN JSON_VALID(c3) THEN c3 ELSE '[]' END AS dj,
  CASE WHEN raw IS NULL OR raw = '' THEN 0 WHEN JSON_VALID(raw) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS cut
  FROM d0b),
h0 AS (SELECT d0.k, jt.hi, jt.os, jt.ol, jt.ns, jt.nl, CAST(jt.lines AS CHAR) AS lj, JSON_LENGTH(jt.lines) AS ln
  FROM d0, JSON_TABLE(d0.dj, '$[*]' COLUMNS (hi FOR ORDINALITY, os INT PATH '$.oldStart', ol INT PATH '$.oldLines',
    ns INT PATH '$.newStart', nl INT PATH '$.newLines', lines JSON PATH '$.lines')) jt),
h1 AS (SELECT k, hi, CASE WHEN ln > 0 THEN
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
      SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(lj, '\\\\', CHAR(1)), '\\"', CHAR(2)), 3, CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(REPLACE(lj, '\\\\', CHAR(1)), '\\"', CHAR(2))) - 4),
      '", "', CHAR(10)), '\\t', CHAR(9)), '\\r', ''), '\\n', CHAR(10)), CHAR(2), '"'), CHAR(1), '\\')
    ELSE '' END AS body,
    CONCAT('@@ -', os, ',', ol, ' +', ns, ',', nl, ' @@') AS head FROM h0),
h2 AS (SELECT k, hi, CONCAT(head, CASE WHEN body <> '' THEN CONCAT(CHAR(10), body) ELSE '' END) AS txt,
    (CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body)) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body), CONCAT(CHAR(10), '+'), ''))) / 2 AS plus,
    (CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body)) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(CONCAT(CHAR(10), body), CONCAT(CHAR(10), '-'), ''))) / 2 AS minus
  FROM h1),
hc (k, hi, txt) AS (SELECT k, hi, txt FROM h2 WHERE hi = 1
  UNION ALL SELECT hc.k, h2.hi, CONCAT(hc.txt, CHAR(10), h2.txt) FROM hc JOIN h2 ON h2.k = hc.k AND h2.hi = hc.hi + 1),
dt AS (SELECT hc.k, hc.txt, m.plus, m.minus, m.hunks FROM hc
  JOIN (SELECT k, MAX(hi) AS hunks, SUM(plus) AS plus, SUM(minus) AS minus FROM h2 GROUP BY k) m ON m.k = hc.k AND m.hunks = hc.hi),
ch AS (SELECT src.k, src.tool, src.file_path, src.content,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.txt
       WHEN src.content IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('+', REPLACE(src.content, CHAR(10), CONCAT(CHAR(10), '+')))
       WHEN src.diff IS NOT NULL AND src.diff <> '' THEN CONCAT('(no complete diff line before the cut; raw value:)', CHAR(10), src.diff) END AS txt,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.plus WHEN src.content IS NOT NULL THEN CHAR_LENGTH(src.content) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(src.content, CHAR(10), '')) + 1 ELSE 0 END AS plus,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.minus ELSE 0 END AS minus,
  CASE WHEN dt.k IS NOT NULL THEN dt.hunks ELSE 0 END AS hunks,
  COALESCE(d0.cut, 0) AS cut,
  CASE WHEN src.diff IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(src.diff) ELSE LENGTH(src.content) END AS bytes
  FROM src LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.k = src.k LEFT JOIN d0 ON d0.k = src.k)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(CAST(sp.st AS SIGNED) / 1000000000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Time`,
       COALESCE(ch.tool, '') AS `Tool`, COALESCE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ch.file_path, '/', -2), '') AS `File`,
       CONCAT('+', ch.plus, ' -', ch.minus) AS `+/-`,
       CASE WHEN ch.txt IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('<details><summary>', CONCAT('+', ch.plus, ' -', ch.minus, CASE WHEN ch.hunks > 0 THEN CONCAT(' · ', ch.hunks, CASE WHEN ch.hunks = 1 THEN ' hunk' ELSE ' hunks' END) ELSE ' · new content' END, CASE WHEN ch.cut = 1 THEN ' · cut' ELSE '' END), '</summary>', CHAR(10), CHAR(10), CONCAT('~~~~~~~~~~diff', CHAR(10), REPLACE(CONCAT('--- ', COALESCE(ch.file_path, ''), CHAR(10), '+++ ', COALESCE(ch.file_path, ''), CHAR(10), ch.txt), '~~~~~', '~~~~⁠~'), CHAR(10), '~~~~~~~~~~'), CHAR(10), CHAR(10), '</details>') END AS `Diff`,
       CASE WHEN ch.cut = 1 THEN CONCAT('diff cut at ', ch.bytes, ' bytes by Tempo (max_attribute_bytes): later lines missing') ELSE CASE WHEN ch.bytes BETWEEN 2045 AND 2051 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 4093 AND 4099 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 8189 AND 8195 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 16381 AND 16387 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 32765 AND 32771 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 65533 AND 65539 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 131069 AND 131075 OR ch.bytes BETWEEN 262141 AND 262147 THEN CONCAT('probably cut by Tempo at ', ch.bytes, ' bytes (max_attribute_bytes): first part only') WHEN ch.bytes >= 61000 THEN 'near the 60 KB cap Claude Code puts on tool content: may be cut' ELSE '' END END AS `Note`,
       RIGHT(COALESCE(sp.tool_use_id, ''), 8) AS `Step`, sp.traceID AS `Trace`,
       COALESCE(sp.tool_use_id, '') AS tool_use_id, sp.traceID AS trace_id_raw, sp.st AS st
FROM ch JOIN sp ON sp.spanID = ch.k
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, '', '', '', 'No Edit or Write content in this conversation: pick a conversation (Conversation = All shows none), or its agent runs without OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1.',
       '', '', '', '', '', '0'
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM src) z WHERE z.c = 0
) u ORDER BY st DESC
